title: Finite evaluation of the canonical bridge equation for a refinement
statement: For finite-field data D, a system realization z, a quasi-compact refinement r:c→d and a system M, applying the mth coefficient evaluation to the canonical bridge equation of z.properOpen gives the corresponding equality of evaluated composites.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence: canonical bridge transport before finite coordinate cancellation.

proof.text: Apply congrArg to the canonical field of ProperOpenCoherence and use functoriality of coefficient evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Canonical bridge transport in the compactification-independence calculation.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalEvaluation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (o : Operations l E) (z : Realizations l E D o) (m : ℕ) {X Y : Spaces D} {f : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f.hom.left] (c d : Compactification f.hom.left) (r : c.Refinement d) [QuasiCompact c.i] [QuasiCompact d.i] (M : System l E X.obj.left) : (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E d.Z m).map ((z.properOpen.gamma c.i (𝟙 X.obj.left) r.hom d.i (r.i_hom.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)).app M ≫ (z.canonicalBridge.push l E r.hom).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj M) ≫ (SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) r.hom).map ((z.canonicalBridge.shriek l E c.i).hom.app M)) = (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E d.Z m).map ((z.canonicalBridge.shriek l E d.i).hom.app ((Operations.push l E o (𝟙 X.obj.left)).obj M) ≫ (SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) d.i).map ((z.canonicalBridge.push l E (𝟙 X.obj.left)).hom.app M) ≫ (SemilinearProperOpen.gamma (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) c.i (𝟙 X.obj.left) r.hom d.i (r.i_hom.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)).app M)
